mechanism_narrative: FGFR1 (RTK) and OSMR (cytokine receptor, JAK-associated) are forced into proximity by an exposit_rigid scaffold. FGFR1's kinase transphosphorylates OSMR's intracellular tyrosines, creating docking sites for GRB2/SHC1 (MAPK), GAB1/PIK3R1 (PI3K-AKT), and STAT3 (JAK-STAT). OSMR-associated JAK1/2 reciprocally phosphorylate FGFR1 tyrosines, amplifying STAT3/5 recruitment. The rigid geometry and large ECD asymmetry (355 vs 713 aa) sterically exclude PLCG1/2 (cannot bridge the kinase-substrate gap) and CBL (ubiquitin ligase). The biased output is MAPK + PI3K-AKT + JAK-STAT activation without PLCγ/Ca²⁺ signaling, producing a transcriptional program that upregulates muscle structural/contractile genes (young-enriched) and suppresses aged IEG/inflammatory markers.
